title: emulsified rich portuguese bread gratin
description: a silky and comforting portuguese dish featuring a rich sauce and crunchy bread topping.
instructions: in a large saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
whisk in the flour to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
slowly whisk in the dijon and english mustard.
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened.
remove from heat and stir in the beaten egg, cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the cubed bread in the bottom.
pour the cheese sauce over the bread, then top with the remaining bread.
dot the top of the bread with the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown.
remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
